question: What universal range must be encompassed when meditating in every place?
premises: Meditation is performed in place after place.
The object of meditation is that previously indicated.
Its range extends from Śiva down to Avīci.
inference: The meditation must encompass the entire spectrum from Śiva to the lowest hell.
plain_english: Having meditated on him in place after place, as extending from Śiva down to Avīci...
